title: Kong and Hitachi launch governed AI-agent integration offering in Japan
summary: Hitachi expanded and launched an AI-agent integration solution and Kong support offering that combines Hitachi identity and systems-integration capabilities with Kong API and AI gateway products for governed enterprise deployment in Japan.
confirmed: Hitachi and Kong announced a partnership supporting enterprise AI and API infrastructure in Japan.
Hitachi began offering an expanded AI-agent integration solution that combines Kong API and AI gateway products with identity, governance, observability and cost-control capabilities.
The companies said they will focus joint proposals and deployment support on manufacturing and financial-sector use cases.
uncertain: Neither company disclosed contract value, bookings, revenue contribution, customer count or adoption.
The announcement does not confirm company-wide ARR, margins, cash flow, dilution or an IPO filing or timetable.
